jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (ID/MY)
jobs.content:
<div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://www.xendit.co/en/">Xendit</a> is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.</p></div><h3>About the Job</h3>
<p>At Xendit, we are looking for a <strong>Customer Success Manager (CSM)</strong> to support our <strong>Indonesia/ Malaysia clients</strong>
